results_and_limits.Figure3B: Phospho-ERK/total ERK and phospho-c-Jun/total c-Jun at three hours; qualitative pathway modulation, no densitometry or target-resistant rescue.
results_and_limits.Figure3C: Graph estimates: inhibitor arms approximately 95–100% XTT at 12 hours versus approximately 20% carrier; approximately 23–29% in inhibitor arms at 24–36 hours. Not individual raw data or a direct survival count.
results_and_limits.XTT_variance: Three independent experiments with technical triplicates. Methods describe representative-experiment replicate SD, while legend describes three independent experiments; variance denominator unresolved.
results_and_limits.statistics: Student t-test/ANOVA; stars P<0.05. No exact P values or stated multiplicity adjustment.
results_and_limits.flow_denominator: Representative plots from three repeats described as similar; no aggregate confidence interval or effect test. Filtrate removed, washed twice, adherent cells harvested. Detached fraction not clearly included; not percentages of all starting cells.
results_and_limits.Figure4_timing: Actin panel at eight hours; flow Results and panel caption at twelve hours, despite opening legend referring to eight hours.

bub1b.measurement: Bulk RNA in fungal-challenge contrast; not inhibitor treatment or BUBR1 protein.
bub1b.contrast: Wild-type versus PrtT-deficient fungal filtrate at eight hours.
bub1b.direction: Higher with wild-type filtrate, consistent with main Table 4.
bub1b.replication: Three wild-type and two PrtT samples after one PrtT sample removed as outlier.
bub1b.adjustment: Broader selection uses stated FDR and fold-change filters; displayed row P value is labelled TtestP-value, not a separate adjusted gene P value.

checkpoint_counterevidence.reading_depth: Abstract and indexed primary Results/legends; complete Methods and original figures not obtained. Efetch supplies front matter only.
checkpoint_counterevidence.findings: SP600125 overrides spindle-poison arrest in U2OS from approximately 2.5 micromolar. Mps1 inhibition and resistant-mutant rescue support mechanism; kinetochore BubR1 recruitment decreases. BJ-Tert resists full override at 10 micromolar.
checkpoint_counterevidence.interpretation: Context-dependent contrary evidence for faithful-division rescue, not proven patient-cell harm.

decisions.SP600125: Retain injury positive and checkpoint counter-probe; decline faithful-division restoration lead.
decisions.comparison: No MVA or muscle benefit established. Apply the same functional/fidelity standard to provisional niacin/apitegromab; no numerical ranking or nominee change.

independent_check: Second reader verified injury-source Methods/Results, Figures 3–4 and Table S7. Final appraisal check passed; secondary checkpoint dose details and supplier listings were outside that independent scope.
